tal-a23-p01 · verses 23.1-23.10 · WITHHELD

athābhiṣekasya vidhiḥ kathyate pārameśvaraḥ yaiṣā putrakadīkṣoktā gurusādhakayorapi / saivādhikāriṇī bhogyatattvayuktimatī kramāt svabhyastajñāninaṃ santaṃ bubhūṣumatha bhāvinam / yogyaṃ jñātvā svādhikāraṃ gurustasmai samarpayet yo naivaṃ veda naivāsāvabhiṣikto@pi daiśikaḥ / samayyādikrameṇeti śrīmatkāmika ucyate yo na vedādhvasandhānaṃ ṣoḍhā bāhyāntarasthitam / sa gururmocayenneti siddhayogīśvarīmate sarvalakṣaṇahīno@pi jñānavān gururiṣyate / jñānaprādhānyamevoktamiti śrīkacabhārgave padavākyapramāṇajñaḥ śivabhaktyekatatparaḥ / samastaśivaśāstrārthaboddhā kāruṇiko guruḥ na svayaṃbhūstasya coktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ parameśinā / abhakto jīvitadhiyā kurvannīśānadhiṣṭhitaḥ paścātmanā svayaṃbhūṣṇurnādhikārī sa kutracit / bhasmāṅkuro vratisuto duḥśīlātanayastathā kuṇḍo golaśca te duṣṭā uktaṃ devyākhyayāmale / punarbhūścānyaliṅgo yaḥ punaḥ śaive pratiṣṭhitaḥ

tal-a23-p02 · verses 23.11-23.20 · WITHHELD

śrīpūrvaśāstre na tveṣa niyamaḥ ko@pi coditaḥ / yathārthatattvasaṃghajñastathā śiṣye prakāśakaḥ yaḥ punaḥ sarvatattvāni vettītyādi ca lakṣaṇam / yogacāre ca yadyatra tantre coditamācaret tathaiva siddhaye seyamājñeti kila varṇitam / yastu karmitayācāryastatra kāṇādivarjanam yataḥ kārakasāmagryātkarmaṇo nādhikaḥ kvacit / devyā yāmalaśāstre ca kāñcyādiparivarjanam taddṛṣṭadoṣātkrodhādeḥ samyakjñātaryasau kutaḥ / guravastu svayaṃbhvādi varjyaṃ yadyāmalādiṣu karmyabhiprāyataḥ sarvaṃ taditi vyācacakṣire / ato deśakulācāradehalakṣaṇakalpanām anādṛtyaiva saṃpūrṇajñānaṃ kuryādgururgurum / prāgvatsaṃpūjya hutvā ca śrāvayitvā cikīrṣitam tato@bhiṣiñcettaṃ śiṣyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā tataḥ sakṛt / tanmantrarasatoyena pūrvoktavidhinā guruḥ vibhavena suvistīrṇaṃ tatastasmai vadetsvakam / sarvaṃ kartavyasāraṃ yacchāstrāṇāṃ paramaṃ rahaḥ anugrāhyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ śivaśaktipracoditāḥ / uktaṃ jñānottare caitadbrāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ

tal-a23-p03 · verses 23.21-23.30 · WITHHELD

napuṃsakāḥ striyaḥ śūdrā ye cānye@pi tadarthinaḥ / te dīkṣāyāṃ na mīmāṃsyā jñānakāle vicārayet jñānamūlo guruḥ proktaḥ saptasatrīṃ pravartayet / dīkṣā vyākhyā kṛpā maitrī śāstracintā śivaikatā annādidānamityetatpālayetsaptasatrakam / abhiṣekavidhau cāsmai karaṇīkhaṭikādikam sarvopakaraṇavrātamarpaṇīyaṃ vipaścite / so@bhiṣikto guruṃ paścāddakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjayet jñānahīno guruḥ karmī svādhikāraṃ samarpya no / dīkṣādyadhikṛtiṃ kuryādvinā tasyājñayā punaḥ ityevaṃ śrāvayetso@pi namaskṛtyābhinandayet / tataḥ prabhṛtyasau pūrvo gurustyaktādhikārakaḥ yathecchaṃ vicaredvyākhyādīkṣādau yantraṇojjhitaḥ / kurvanna bādhyate yasmāddīpāddīpavadīdṛśaḥ santāno nādhikārasya cyavo@kurvanna bādhyate / prāk ca kurvanvihanyeta siddhātantre taducyate yathārthamupadeśaṃ tu kurvannācārya ucyate / na cāvajñā kriyākāle saṃsāroddharaṇaṃ prati na dīkṣeta guruḥ śiṣyaṃ tattvayuktastu garvataḥ / yo@sya syānnarake vāsa iha ca vyādhito bhavet

tal-a23-p04 · verses 23.31-23.40 · WITHHELD

prāptābhiṣekaḥ sa guruḥ ṣaṇmāsānmantrapaddhatim / sarvāṃ tantroditāṃ dhyāyejjapeccātanmayatvataḥ yadaiva tanmayībhūtastadā vīryamupāgataḥ / chindyātpāśāṃstato yatnaṃ kuryāttanmayatāsthitau hṛccakrādutthitā sūkṣmā śaśisphaṭikasaṃnibhā / lekhākārā nādarūpā praśāntā cakrapaṅktigā dvādaśānte nirūḍhā sā sauṣumne tripathāntare / tatra hṛccakramāpūrya japenmantraṃ jvalatprabham cakṣurlomādirandhraughavahajjvālaurvasaṃnibham / yāvacchāntaśikhākīrṇaṃ viśvājyapravilāpakam tadājyadhārāsaṃtṛptamānābhikuharāntaram / evaṃ mantrā mokṣadāḥ syurdīptā buddhāḥ sunirmalāḥ mūlakandanabhonābhihṛtkaṇṭhālikatālugam / ardhendurodhikānādatadantavyāpiśaktigam samanonmanaśuddhātmaparacakrasamāśritam / yatra yatra japeccakre samastavyastabhedanāt tatra tatra mahāmantra iti devyākhyayāmale / vidyāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ mantravīryaprasiddhaye tacca tādātmyameveti yaduktaṃ spandaśāsane / tadākramya balaṃ mantrāḥ sarvajñabalaśālinaḥ

tal-a23-p05 · verses 23.41-23.50 · WITHHELD

pravartante@dhikārāya karaṇānīva dehinām / kṛtavidyāvrataḥ paścāddīkṣāvyākhyādi sarvataḥ kuryādyogyeṣu śiṣyeṣu nāyogyeṣu kadācana / rahasye yojayedvipraṃ parīkṣya viparītataḥ ācārācchaktimapyeva nānyathetyūrmiśāsane / nityādyalpālpakaṃ kuryādyaduktaṃ brahmayāmale cīrṇavidyāvrataḥ sarvaṃ manasā vā smaretpriye / dehasaṃbandhasaṃchannasārvajñyo dambhabhājanam avidandīkṣamāṇo@pi na duṣyeddaiśikaḥ kvacit / jñātvā tvayogyatāṃ nainaṃ dīkṣeta pratyavāyitām buddhvā jñāne śāstrasiddhigurutvādau ca taṃ punaḥ / bhūya eva parīkṣeta tattadaucityaśālinam tatra tatra niyuñjīta natu jātu viparyayāt / nanu tadvastvayogyasya tatrecchā jāyate kutaḥ tadīśādhiṣṭhitecchaiva yogyatāmasya sūcayet / satyaṃ kāpi prabuddhāsāvicchā rūḍhiṃ na gacchati vidyudvatpāpaśīlasya yathā pāpāpavarjane / rūḍhyarūḍhī tadicchāyā api śaṃbhuprasādataḥ aprarūḍhatathecchākastata eva na bhājanam / yaḥ samyagjñānamādāya guruviśvāsavarjitaḥ

tal-a23-p06 · verses 23.51-23.60 · WITHHELD

lokaṃ viplāvayennāsmiñjñāte vijñānamarpayet / ajñāte@pi punarjñāte vijñānaharaṇaṃ caret punaḥpunaryadā jñāto viśvāsaparivarjitaḥ / tadā tamagrato dhyāyetsphurantaṃ candrasūryavat tato nijahṛdambhojabodhāmbarataloditām / svarbhānumalināṃ dhyāyedvāmāṃ śaktiṃ vimohanīm vāmācārakrameṇaināṃ niḥsṛtāṃ sādhyagāminīm / cintayitvā tayā grastaprakāśaṃ taṃ vicintayet anena kramayogena mūḍhabuddherdurātmanaḥ / vijñānamantravidyādyāḥ prakurvantyapakāritām nanu vijñānamātmasthaṃ kathaṃ hartuṃ kṣamaṃ bhavet / ato vijñānaharaṇaṃ kathaṃ śrīpūrva ucyate ucyate nāsya śiṣyasya vijñānaṃ rūḍhimāgatam / tathātve haraṇaṃ kasmātpūrṇayogyatvaśālinaḥ kiṃtveṣa vāmayā śaktyā mūḍho gāḍhaṃ vibhoḥ kṛtaḥ / svabhāvādeva tenāsya vidyādyamapakārakam guruḥ punaḥ śivābhinnaḥ sanyaḥ pañcavidhāṃ kṛtim / kuryādyadi tataḥ pūrṇamadhikāritvamasya tat ato yathā śuddhatattvasṛṣṭisthityormalātyaye / yojanānugrahe kāryacatuṣke@dhikṛto guruḥ

tal-a23-p07 · verses 23.61-23.70 · WITHHELD

śivābhedena tatkuryāttadvatpañcamamapyayam / tirobhāvābhidhaṃ kṛtyaṃ tathāsau śivatātmakaḥ ata eva śive śāstre jñāne cāśvāsabhājanam / gurormūḍhatayā kopadhāmāpi na tirohitaḥ gururhi kupito yasya sa tirohita ucyate / saṃsārī satu devo hi gururna ca mṛṣāvidaḥ tata eva ca śāstrādidūṣako yadyapi krudhā / na dahyate@sau guruṇā tathāpyeṣa tirohitaḥ asmadgurvāgamastveṣa tirobhūte svayaṃ śiśau / na kupyenna śapeddhīmān sa hyanugrāhakaḥ sadā īśecchācoditaḥ pāśaṃ yadi kaṇṭhe nipīḍayet / kimācāryeṇa tatrāsya kāryā syātsahakāritā śivābhinno@pi hi gururanugrahamayīṃ vibhoḥ / mukhyāṃ śaktimupāsīno@nugṛhṇīyātsa sarvathā svātantryamātrajñaptyai tu kathitaṃ śāstra īdṛśam / na kāryaṃ patatāṃ hastālambaḥ sahyo na pātanam ata eva svatantratvādicchāyāḥ punarunmukham / prāyaścittairviśodhyainaṃ dīkṣeta kṛpayā guruḥ ūrdhvadṛṣṭau prapannaḥ sannanāśvastastataḥ param / adhaḥśāstraṃ prapadyāpi na śreyaḥpātratāmiyāt

tal-a23-p08 · verses 23.71-23.80 · WITHHELD

adhodṛṣṭau prapannastu tadanāśvastamānasaḥ / ūrdhvaśāsanabhāk pāpaṃ taccojjhecca śivībhavet rājñe druhyannamātyāṅgabhūto@pi hi vihanyate / viparyayastu netyevamūrdhvāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ samāśrayet śrīpūrvaśāstre tenoktaṃ yāvattenaiva noddhṛtaḥ / atra hyartho@yametāvatpūrvoktajñānavṛṃhitaḥ gurustāvatsa evātra tacchabdenāvamṛśyate / tādṛksvabhyastavijñānabhājordhvapadaśālinā anuddhṛtasya na śreya etadanyagurūddhṛteḥ / ata evāmbujanmārkadṛṣṭānto@tra nirūpitaḥ trijagajjyotiṣo hyanyattejo@nyacca niśākṛtaḥ / jñānamanyattrikaguroranyattvadharavartinām ata eva purābhūtagurvabhāvo yadā tadā / tadanyaṃ lakṣaṇopetamāśrayetpunarunmukhaḥ sati tasmiṃstūnmukhaḥ sankasmājjahyādyadi sphuṭam / syādanyatarago doṣo yo@dhikārāpaghātakaḥ doṣaśceha na lokastho doṣatvena nirūpyate / ajñānakhyāpanāyuktakhyāpanātmā tvasau mataḥ śiṣyasyāpi tathābhūtajñānānāśvastarūpatā / mukhyo doṣastadanye hi doṣāstatprabhavā yataḥ

tal-a23-p09 · verses 23.81-23.90 · WITHHELD

na dhvastavyādhikaḥ ko hi bhiṣajaṃ bahu manyate / asūyurnūnamadhvastavyādhiḥ svasthāyate balāt evaṃ jñānasamāśvastaḥ kiṃ kiṃ na gurave caret / no cennūnamaviśvasto viśvasta iva tiṣṭhati ajñānādaya evaite doṣā na laukikā guroḥ / iti khyāpayituṃ proktaṃ mālinīvijayottare na tasyānveṣayedvṛttaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / sa eva tadvijānāti yuktaṃ cāyuktameva vā akāryeṣu yadā saktaḥ prāṇadravyāpahāriṣu / tadā nivāraṇīyo@sau praṇatena vipaścitā viśeṣaṇamakāryāṇāmuktābhiprāyameva yat / tenātivāryamāṇo@pi yadyasau na nivartate tadānyatra kvacidgatvā śivamevānucintayet / na hyasya sa gurutve syāddoṣo yenoṣare kṛṣim kuryādvrajenniśāyāṃ vā sa tvarthaprāṇahārakaḥ / tadīyāpriyabhīrustu paraṃ tādṛśamācaret yatastadapriyaṃ naiṣa śṛṇuyāditi bhāṣitam / śrīmātaṅge taduktaṃ ca nādhītaṃ bhūmabhītitaḥ yaccaitaduktametāvatkartavyamiti taddhruvam / tīvraśaktigṛhītānāṃ svayameva hṛdi sphuret

upadeśastvayaṃ mandamadhyaśakternijāṃ kramāt / śaktiṃ jvalayituṃ proktaḥ sā hyevaṃ jājvalītyalam dṛḍhānurāgasubhagasaṃrambhābhogabhāginaḥ / svollāsi smarasarvasyaṃ dārḍhyāyānyatra dṛśyate nanveṣa kasmāddṛṣṭāntaḥ kimetenāśubhaṃ kṛtam / citspandaḥ sarvago bhinnādupādheḥ sa tathā tathā bhavetko@pi tirobhūtaḥ punarunmukhito@pi san / vināpi daiśikātprāgvatsvayameva vimucyate prakārastveṣa nātroktaḥ śaktipātabalādgataḥ / asaṃbhāvyatayā cātra dṛḍhakopaprasādavat ityeṣa yo guroḥ prokto vidhistaṃ pālayedguruḥ / anyathā na śivaṃ yāyācchrīmatsāre ca varṇitam anyāyaṃ ye prakurvanti śāstrārthaṃ varjayantyalam / te@rdhanārīśapuragā guravaḥ samayacyutāḥ anyatrāpyadhikāraṃ ca neyādvidyeśatāṃ vrajet / anyatra samayatyāgātkravyādatvaṃ śataṃ samāḥ iyattatratyatātparyaṃ siddhāntagururunnayaḥ / bhavetpiśācavidyeśaḥ śuddha eva tu tāntrikaḥ ṣaḍardhadaiśikaścārdhanārīśabhuvanasthitiḥ / eṣā karmapradhānānāṃ gurūṇāṃ gatirucyate
